Red Desire (Summer Tracksuit - Wet variant off) walks in
Checking conditions outside

It is all because you joined me in my prayers!
I am truly, deeply grateful...!

O heavens, O earth, O spirits omnipresent across "that land"...!
Grant the power of mana unto my prayers—!
(Drip... Drop...)

On a rest day during summer training camp, I enjoy sunbathing on a beach nearby.
As I close my eyes—

B-But we have come all this way!
And this is the only rest day we have left...!

Ehehe♪ Thank goodness...!
It is truly adorable, isn't it?

What I hold in my heart then will surely be great hope for "that land."
...Along with my feelings for this world... ...

My, look over there.
A squirrel is grooming its fur.

It is the sights we saw together, the flavors we shared,
and the memory of praying together in the rain without giving up...

One day, it will surely arrive.
The day you see me off as I step through the gate to the otherworld.

Truly?! Then by all means!
Let us embark together!

Goodness...!?
Even though the forecast predicted clear skies today...!
Squeak, squeal!

Fufufu, allow me to grant guidance to my wandering Trainer.
Look, right where I point—

Even so, I will not halt my steps.
For I am a saint burdened with a sacred mission.

Come, just a little further.
The promised place is almost—

Hehe, I added a touch of mugwort I grew with my own hands.
Its distinct aroma brings out the sweetness, does it not?

That's right. We cannot linger here.
Come, Trainer! To our promised place!

A nourishing treat crafted with all of a saint's devotion.
I truly hope it suits your taste.
May this day, which I can walk alongside you—!

I will be warmly welcomed and blessed as a saint...
Yet beside that, I will surely feel an irremediable sense of loss.
(Shaaaaa... aaaah... ...)

Yes, truly...
If a gate to another world were to open, it might look just like this.

...It is fine. Rain like this will surely stop soon.
Look, we do not need to worry about getting wet here...

We did it... We did it! We truly did it!!
Trainer, our prayers have—!!

Seeing her pray with such fervent devotion, I couldn't bring myself to say "let's give up."
Standing beside Red Desire, I clasp my hands before my chest.

To tell the truth, I received guidance from a sacred voice.
It said, "A special view awaits within the forest ahead"—

Until the day of my departure, may my steps forward
be warmly filled with memories like today's—

Red Desire offers her prayers up toward the heavens.
Even so, the rain continues to pour...

That "light" will surely illuminate my path in "that land."
That is why I wish to weave precious memories in this world.

Red Desire happily bounds ahead. Seeing the cookies prepared,
she must have been planning this picnic for quite some time.

That is why—I do not want to give up on today, on this very moment.
I do not want this special time to be washed away by the rain.

...
...I understand.
No. ...—No!
Ah! Trainer...

In that case—I shall appease the heavens!!
With the power of sacred prayer!!

Once the gate to "that land" opens...
there is no guarantee I can stand here like this next year.
...Huh?

Please, will you walk it?
This journey through this world, together with me.

I wish to go and see it with my very own eyes.
And so... if you would like, won't you join me?

I have no idea how long we stayed like that.
However, the sound of rain grew gradually quieter, and at last—
—Fufu. Come, Trainer.
Trainer... Trainer...

Stepping outside, everything was bathed in a vibrant orange.
Looking up, there was hardly a cloud in sight.

Trainer. Aren't you getting hungry by now?
Please, have a cookie if you'd like.

The "special scenery" that finally revealed itself was truly magical.
Illuminated by the setting sun, the hollow in the rock looked just like a gateway to another world.
(――*SHSHSHSHSH*...!)

...A shadow falls over me sometimes.
Whenever I think of the view in "that place" without you.
With you, and no one else.
(*crunch, munch*...)

That is why I have made up my mind.
I will hold "light" within myself, so that no "shadow" may fall upon my heart.

Heavens... please, if only for today.
Enfold this sky in your quiet blessing...!

I walk alongside Red Desire toward the depths of the forest.
Along the way, it felt like a cheerful picnic――

Some time had passed since we took shelter in the cave, but the rain showed no signs of stopping.
After notifying the training camp on my smartphone, I checked the time.

――O Heavens, O Earth, and all the spirits of "that land."
Grant a humble blessing upon the two walking this ground.

...Trainer.
I am the Umamusume in your charge――and your holy maiden.
